trigger.description: Swarm brief sees br sync metadata report JSONL freshness drift, then confirms with br doctor that DB and JSONL record counts match and dirty_count is zero. The record-count parity is useful diagnosis, but metadata drift still makes Beads read authority stale for claim/reopen/close decisions.
setup_commands: # create a Beads workspace where br sync --status --json reports jsonl_newer=true and dirty_count=0
# ensure br doctor --json --no-db reports equal DB/JSONL counts, zero dirty issues, and no parse hazards

message_contains: Beads sync metadata reports JSONL freshness drift

repair_safety.manualStep: Coordinate before mutating shared tracker state.
